title: CSS_battle
summary: A personal repository of CSS Battle event solutions that also contains a notebook tutorial demonstrating SDV's CTGAN synthesizer on a demo hotel guests dataset. The notebook imports sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer, fits it, and evaluates results using sdv.evaluation.single_table's diagnostic and quality-report functions.
needs: Notebook appears to be an unmodified SDV tutorial copy; unrelated to the CSS Battle repo's stated purpose.
